title: Google has stopped pushing Git tags for some Android source code
titleZh: 谷歌已停止推送部分 Android 源代码的 Git 标签
author: Animux
relevanceReason: 命中 1 个 AI/科技关键词。
summaryRaw: Google replaced pushing Git tags for certain source code with obtaining source code via Google Drive after making a request through Google Forms. It's completely ridiculous and they've gradually become very slow at handling requests. They're in clear violation of the GPLv2 now.
summaryZh: Google replaced pushing Git tags for certain source code with obtaining source code via Google Drive after making a request through Google Forms. It's completely ridiculous and they've gradually become very slow at handling requests. They're in clear violation of the GPLv2 now.

comments.author: grapheneos
comments.textRawHtml:
They stopped pushing tags for any of the Pixel kernel or userspace driver repositories to AOSP. They also stopped pushing AOSP releases specific to Pixels which is why AOSP now only gets yearly releases, QPR2 releases and security backports to both of those. Other OEMs use the yearly and theoretically also the QPR2 releases. Both the yearly and QPR2 releases get monthly security backports. Since they dropped Pixel support from AOSP, they don't push the releases not shipped by other OEMs anymore.

These changes directly led to our Motorola partnership. One of their security people reached out to us after seeing our posts about this with the launch of Android 16. We haven't talked about it much since then since we adapted to it during the several weeks it delayed our Android 16 port. We then continued adapting to it and have fully worked around it. It was an ongoing problem but not a new one and we had accepted we had to deal with it as the new normal.

They were previously responding to our kernel source requests within a day. It was often done without hours. Despite the archaic system, this part wasn't that bad. Recently, they've been taking weeks or longer to get back to us for the requests which is ridiculous. It's the direct result of purposely adding a lot of friction with manual handling of the requests even if the delays weren't directly planned by management.

Weeks or months of delay is not reasonable for one of the largest tech companies in the world. GPL doesn't set a standard time limit for providing the sources, but that doesn't mean they can delay it indefinitely. They need to do it in a reasonable amount of time. What's reasonable for one of the largest tech companies in the world in 2026 with current technology is not the same as what was reasonable 30 years ago. Google chose to come up with a archaic way of distributing the sources involving someone manually going through a list and sharing Google Drive access. It's a deliberate way of making it painful. If they can't keep up with it and it gets delayed for weeks or months then they're not complying with the GPL by not providing it in a reasonable amount of time. Law is not code and a time limit not being explicitly written down doesn't mean there isn't a limit to what's reasonable for compliance.

They'll sell far fewer Pixels because of these overall changes. It pushes GrapheneOS and other projects towards other devices instead. For us, Pixels are being used due to security rather than ease of supporting them. It's now a lot harder to deal with Pixels than it would be for many other devices but they're currently still the most secure option. We're working on changing that and have a lot less reason to contribute to improving Pixels. We helped them fix serious security weaknesses for Pixels including vulnerabilities being exploited in the wild by forensic data extraction companies. Pixel security with the stock OS would be worse without GrapheneOS.
comments.textZhHtml:
他们停止将任何 Pixel 内核或用户空间驱动程序存储库的标签推送到 AOSP。他们还停止推送特定于 Pixel 的 AOSP 版本，这就是为什么 AOSP 现在只获得年度版本、QPR2 版本以及这两个版本的安全向后移植。其他 OEM 厂商也使用每年发布的 QPR2 版本，理论上也是如此。年度版本和 QPR2 版本均获得每月安全向后移植。由于他们放弃了 AOSP 对 Pixel 的支持，因此他们不再推送其他 OEM 厂商未发布的版本。

这些变化直接促成了我们与摩托罗拉的合作关系。他们的一位安全人员在看到我们关于 Android 16 发布的帖子后联系了我们。从那以后我们就没有过多谈论它，因为我们在 Android 16 端口延迟的几周内适应了它。然后我们继续适应它并完全解决它。这是一个持续存在的问题，但不是一个新问题，我们已经接受必须将其作为新常态来处理。

他们之前在一天内响应了我们的内核源请求。这通常不需要几个小时就能完成。尽管系统陈旧，但这部分还不错。最近，他们花了几周或更长时间才回复我们的请求，这很荒谬。这是故意在手动处理请求时增加大量摩擦的直接结果，即使延迟不是由管理层直接计划的。

对于世界上最大的科技公司之一来说，数周或数月的延迟是不合理的。 GPL 没有设定提供源代码的标准时间限制，但这并不意味着他们可以无限期地推迟。他们需要在合理的时间内完成它。对于 2026 年世界上最大的科技公司之一来说，以现有技术来看，合理的做法与 30 年前的合理做法不同。谷歌选择提出一种古老的方式来分发源，需要有人手动浏览列表并共享谷歌云端硬盘访问权限。这是一种故意让它变得痛苦的方式。如果他们跟不上它并且延迟了几周或几个月，那么他们没有在合理的时间内提供它，就没有遵守 GPL。法律不是代码，没有明确写下的时间限制并不意味着对合理合规性没有限制。

由于这些总体变化，他们销售的像素会少得多。它将 GrapheneOS 和其他项目推向其他设备。对我们来说，使用 Pixel 是因为安全性而不是易于支持。现在处理 Pixel 比处理许多其他设备要困难得多，但它们仍然是目前最安全的选择。我们正在努力改变这一点，并且没有太多理由为提高像素做出贡献。我们帮助他们修复了 Pixel 的严重安全漏洞，包括被法医数据提取公司在野外利用的漏洞。如果没有 GrapheneOS，现有操作系统的像素安全性会更差。

children.author: grapheneos
children.textRawHtml: They did it for many years with 0 delay because they pushed the tags to AOSP. It was moved to Google Drive with a Google Forms setup to request access with manual fulfillment of the request. It was deliberately done to make it into a hassle. The delays are by design through making it a manual system regardless of how much of a delay was intended as part of this change. They could be automatically handling the requests especially from people who have already been given sources for a product. They're deliberately making it take substantially more work on their end to make it into more of a hassle.
children.textZhHtml: 他们这样做了很多年，零延迟，因为他们将标签推送到了 AOSP。它被转移到 Google Drive，并通过 Google Forms 设置来请求访问并手动满足请求。故意这样做，就是为了惹麻烦。这些延迟是通过使其成为手动系统而设计的，无论此更改的目的是延迟多少。他们可以自动处理请求，特别是来自已经获得产品来源的人的请求。他们故意让它需要更多的工作来使其变得更加麻烦。

children.author: patcon
children.textRawHtml:
I was involved in one of the communities involved in the Block Sidewalk efforts in Toronto Canada, which prevented Sidewalk Labs from moving forward on a multi-billion dollar project to redevelop a chunk of downtown Toronto.

I was at the Data Power 2017 conference in Ottawa where I shared with people (who would become key Block Sidewalk organizers) the clues I had, that Google was about to bid on the as-yet-unknown land development opportunity, closing later that month.

I had previously been in collaboration with secure ROM developers hitting their first adversarial efforts to thwart use of Android for alt app markets. I know that Google's public story of Android openness (which drove people trusting them to build a city platform) was bullshit, and I made sure many many of the key activists and public servants knew it.

While I can't know exactly how my specific actions affected things, I would guarantee that Google's adversarial positions and failed stewardship have already contributed to them losing real opportunities.
children.textZhHtml:
我参与了加拿大多伦多 Block Sidewalk 项目的一个社区，该社区阻止了 Sidewalk Labs 推进一项耗资数十亿美元的项目，以重新开发多伦多市中心的一大片区域。

我参加了在渥太华举行的 Data Power 2017 会议，在会上我与人们（他们后来成为 Block Sidewalk 的主要组织者）分享了我所掌握的线索，即 Google 即将竞标尚未可知的土地开发机会，该月晚些时候关闭。

我之前曾与安全 ROM 开发人员合作，进行了第一次对抗性努力，以阻止 Android 在替代应用市场中的使用。我知道谷歌关于 Android 开放性的公开故事（这促使人们相信他们建立了一个城市平台）是一派胡言，而且我确保许多重要的活动家和公务员都知道这一点。

虽然我无法确切知道我的具体行动如何影响事情，但我可以保证谷歌的敌对立场和失败的管理已经导致他们失去了真正的机会。

children.author: e12e
children.textRawHtml:
There's no reasonable delay. The source code needs to exist before binary distribution.

When google distribute the compiled code to me, I assume the source is already available.

If distribution means I buy a phone with compiled code, I expect the sources to be readily available.

I distribution means my phone download updated software - I expect the code to be available.

Only lasts until google pushes out gpl in favour of fuchsia or something - so they can finally run away from the community code they built the android system on. Bit until then I fully expect them to actually honor the license...
children.textZhHtml:
没有合理的延迟。在二进制分发之前，源代码需要存在。

当 google 将编译后的代码分发给我时，我假设源代码已经可用。

如果分发意味着我购买带有编译代码的手机，我希望源代码随时可用。

我分发意味着我的手机下载更新的软件 - 我希望代码可用。

仅持续到谷歌推出 gpl 以支持紫红色或其他东西 - 这样他们最终可以逃离他们构建 Android 系统的社区代码。直到那时我完全希望他们能够真正遵守许可证......

children.author: account42
children.textRawHtml: GPL does explicitly allow for only providing source code on request. But of course that doesn't mean you can arbitrarily delay responses to such requests.
children.textZhHtml: GPL 明确允许仅根据请求提供源代码。但这当然并不意味着您可以任意延迟对此类请求的响应。

children.author: bulder
children.textRawHtml:
A reasonable interpretation would be that they had a previous process that eliminated delivery latency and required no manual manpower for responding, so changing it has been done to induce artificial friction, against the intent of the license.

Not that the intent of a license can be enforced.

并不是说可以强制执行许可证的意图。
